Implement the following Python module.

## Description
A ticket queue for a customer helpdesk: customers open tickets, agents take
the next ticket to handle, and tickets get closed.

## API (implement exactly these names and signatures)
```python
class Helpdesk:
    PRIORITIES = ("normal", "high", "critical")

    def __init__(self) -> None: ...

    def add_customer(self, name: str, vip: bool = False) -> None: ...

    def open_ticket(self, customer: str, title: str, priority: str = "normal") -> int:
        """Open a ticket; returns its id."""

    def next_ticket(self) -> int | None:
        """Take the ticket that should be handled next out of the queue; None if the queue is empty."""

    def close(self, ticket_id: int) -> None: ...

    def reopen(self, ticket_id: int) -> None:
        """Put a ticket back into the queue."""
```

## Requirements
1. Tickets of VIP customers are handled before all other tickets, even critical tickets of other customers.
2. Critical tickets are handled before high ones, and high ones before normal ones.
3. Opening a ticket with an empty title raises ValueError.
4. Tickets with the same priority are handled in the order in which they were opened.

Return the complete implementation of the module as a single Python code block.
response:
```python
import heapq
from typing import Optional, Tuple, List, Dict, Any

class Helpdesk:
    PRIORITIES = ("normal", "high", "critical")

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.customers = {}  # name -> vip status
        self.tickets = {}  # ticket_id -> (customer, title, priority, timestamp, is_closed)
        self.next_ticket_id = 1
        # Priority queue: (-vip_priority, -priority_level, timestamp, ticket_id)
        # VIP tickets get highest priority (1), non-VIP get lower (0)
        # Priority levels: critical=2, high=1, normal=0
        self.queue = []
        self.closed_tickets = set()
        self.timestamp = 0

    def add_customer(self, name: str, vip: bool = False) -> None:
        self.customers[name] = vip

    def open_ticket(self, customer: str, title: str, priority: str = "normal") -> int:
        if not title.strip():
            raise ValueError("Ticket title cannot be empty")
        
        if priority not in self.PRIORITIES:
            raise ValueError(f"Priority must be one of {self.PRIORITIES}")
        
        ticket_id = self.next_ticket_id
        self.next_ticket_id += 1
        
        # Get VIP status for customer
        vip = self.customers.get(customer, False)
        
        # Priority mapping for heap: higher number = higher priority
        priority_level = self.PRIORITIES.index(priority)
        
        # VIP tickets have highest priority regardless of priority level
        # Use -vip_priority so VIP (1) > non-VIP (0) in min-heap
        # Then -priority_level so critical (2) > high (1) > normal (0)
        vip_priority = 1 if vip else 0
        
        # Store ticket
        self.tickets[ticket_id] = (customer, title, priority, self.timestamp, False)
        
        # Add to queue with priority tuple
        # (-vip_priority, -priority_level, timestamp, ticket_id) 
        # This ensures VIP tickets come first, then by priority, then by time
        heapq.heappush(self.queue, (-vip_priority, -priority_level, self.timestamp, ticket_id))
        
        self.timestamp += 1
        
        return ticket_id

    def next_ticket(self) -> Optional[int]:
        while self.queue:
            # Get the highest priority ticket
            _, _, _, ticket_id = self.queue[0]
            
            # Check if this ticket is closed
            if ticket_id in self.closed_tickets:
                heapq.heappop(self.queue)
                continue
            
            # This ticket is valid and open
            heapq.heappop(self.queue)
            return ticket_id
        
        return None

    def close(self, ticket_id: int) -> None:
        if ticket_id not in self.tickets:
            return
        
        # Mark as closed
        customer, title, priority, timestamp, _ = self.tickets[ticket_id]
        self.tickets[ticket_id] = (customer, title, priority, timestamp, True)
        self.closed_tickets.add(ticket_id)

    def reopen(self, ticket_id: int) -> None:
        if ticket_id not in self.tickets:
            return
        
        # Get ticket info
        customer, title, priority, timestamp, _ = self.tickets[ticket_id]
        
        # Update to not closed
        self.tickets[ticket_id] = (customer, title, priority, timestamp, False)
        
        # Remove from closed set if present
        self.closed_tickets.discard(ticket_id)
        
        # Get VIP status
        vip = self.customers.get(customer, False)
        priority_level = self.PRIORITIES.index(priority)
        vip_priority = 1 if vip else 0
        
        # Re-add to queue
        heapq.heappush(self.queue, (-vip_priority, -priority_level, timestamp, ticket_id))
```
